# Content calendar, 24 Oct to 22 Nov 2026: agencies and travellers

*Generated by `build_drafts.py` from the same list as `drafts.sql`. Edit captions there, run it, and both files follow.*

Every post below is loaded into the dashboard's Channels tab as a **draft** (`social_posts`, status `draft`, source `claude`, no date, no media). Nothing goes out until the founder opens the draft, attaches the video or image, and presses **Publish now** or **Schedule**.

## How each platform takes a draft

| Platform | What happens on Publish | Before you press it |
|---|---|---|
| Instagram | Posts to the feed as a Reel or photo | Attach the video or image; Instagram will not post a caption alone |
| Facebook | Posts to the WanderBuddy Page | Attach the video; a text-only post works but reaches fewer people |
| TikTok | Lands in the TikTok inbox as a draft until TikTok audits the app | In TikTok, paste the caption's first line and hashtags, then post |
| YouTube | Uploads as a Short, **private** until Google audits the project | In YouTube Studio, set it to Public |

Times are GMT+8 (Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bali); Bangkok and Hanoi are an hour earlier. Agency posts go out at 10:00 on working days, traveller posts at 19:30 on weekdays and 11:00 at weekends. Answer every comment in the first hour: comments per reel is the north star in the 2.0 launch plan.

Anything in `[BRACKETS]` must be filled in before publishing. Sample agency screens are always labelled Sample.
